title: 3d Conformal Field Theories via Fuzzy Sphere Algebra
summary: Fuzzy sphere models conjecturally realize 3d CFTs in small systems of spinful fermions, but why they work so well is still not fully understood. Their Hamiltonians are built from electron density operators projected to the lowest Landau level. We analyze the Lie algebra generated by these density modes and its large-$s$ limits. Depending on how the limit is taken, the algebra approaches either the Girvin-MacDonald-Platzman algebra in a local planar limit or a semiclassical algebra for low-angular-momentum modes in a global commutative limit.
